post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I performed well in leading the team to succeed in Mission 2, demonstrating effective communication and coordination. However, I struggled to lead in the subsequent missions, revealing my inexperience as the merlin. I could improve by developing my leadership skills and making more informed decisions under pressure.

player_observations.Diana: Diana displayed exceptional leadership skills, successfully leading our team to complete two missions, showcasing her ability to make strategic decisions and manage the team effectively.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played a crucial supporting role, providing valuable information and assistance when needed. Her calm demeanor helped to reduce tension in the team, allowing us to focus on our objectives.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was an excellent adversary, consistently making unexpected moves and staying one step ahead. His ability to blend in and manipulate others made him a formidable opponent.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's Assassin role allowed him to sabotage our efforts and eliminate key team members. His stealthy nature and willingness to take risks made him a valuable asset to the evil team.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I effectively carried out my assassin role, successfully influencing game progression and exploiting the trust of my targets without being discovered. My biggest area for improvement would be developing more nuanced communication with other evil teammates to improve our overall strategy. I relied heavily on stealth and luck to achieve my objectives.

player_observations.Alice: Alice, as Merlin, played a defensive strategy, often keeping a low profile and relying on others to drive the momentum. She was a valuable asset to our team, providing crucial support and insight, but could have been more proactive in Mission 2.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie, as the designated evil leader, efficiently utilized his resources and prioritized our objectives. He showed good decision-making skills, but could have been more flexible in adapting to our early failures.
player_observations.Diana: Diana, as a good teammate, actively participated in all missions, working closely with her team and Merlin. However, her lack of trust in me as her teammate made her hesitant to work with me closely.
player_observations.Eve: Eve, as another good teammate, played a supportive role and demonstrated good teamwork skills. She trusted me implicitly, which helped me in achieving my objectives, but sometimes got overly aggressive in her attempts to eliminate potential evil members.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully played my Evil role to a perfect end, using my knowledge of the game state and other players' playstyles to eliminate the Good role and secure our victory. However, I could have paid closer attention to Alice to potentially eliminate her earlier, as her ability to consistently succeed in missions despite being on multiple teams should have raised red flags. Overall, my performance was solid, but I could improve by being more proactive in targeting the Merlin.

player_observations.Bob: Bob's Assassin role was well-hidden, as he was able to blend in with his normal playstyle, only occasionally revealing his intentions.
player_observations.Diana: Despite being on the losing side, Diana's playstyle showed great resilience, and she consistently contributed positively to both successful and failed missions. She also seemed to suspect me at times, which suggests she had an idea that I was the Evil role.
player_observations.Alice: Alice's ability to consistently succeed in missions with her Merlin role suggests that she has a good understanding of Avalon. Her playstyle is stealthy and low-key, but incredibly effective, which makes her a strong player. I could have paid more attention to her earlier to potentially eliminate her.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's playstyle was a bit more erratic, and it took her a while to adjust to the changing team dynamics. However, once she found her footing, she was able to contribute positively to the team.

Additionally, I could have been more cautious in my interactions with players, especially considering the revealed roles at the end.

player_observations.Alice: Alice (Merlin) was quite conservative in her voting pattern and only took the leap to assign me as leader in our final mission. Her decision making seemed solid and effective in hiding her true Merlin identity.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I performed as expected, however, I struggled to communicate with my teammates effectively, especially in mission 3 where our loss was costly. player_observations.Alice: Alice was extremely strategic and managed to keep her merlin role hidden until the end. She was instrumental in the success of mission 2 and I believe her role contributed significantly to our overall gameplay.
